narrative.overview: Drawing stock, ultramarine ink, and precise rules frame the CV. Archivo headings lead each record, and numbered figures explain the architecture.
keyCharacteristics: An amber delivery trace across labelled drawing planes.

rules.name: The Amber Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve amber for the drawing trace, figure labels, and interactions on indigo surfaces.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate records with thin rules and use solid fields for featured evidence.

dos: Lead with names and actual qualifications.
Keep focus visible and respect reduced motion.
donts: Keep gradients and shadows out of evidence surfaces.
